title: Sparkly popsicle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- popsicle stick -->
  <rect x='42' y='68' width='16' height='26' rx='5' fill='#D9A066' stroke='#F0C27D' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- popsicle body -->
  <rect x='25' y='15' width='50' height='58' rx='18' fill='#FF5A7A'/>
  <!-- popsicle top rounded highlight -->
  <path d='M33 25 Q50 10 67 25' fill='none' stroke='#FF8FA8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- lighter side shading -->
  <path d='M32 30 Q25 48 31 66' fill='none' stroke='#FF8FA8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- drips -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='70' r='5' fill='#FF5A7A'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='70' r='5' fill='#FF5A7A'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE66D'>
    <!-- top left sparkle -->
    <path d='M15 20 L17 26 L23 28 L17 30 L15 36 L13 30 L7 28 L13 26 Z'/>
    <!-- top right sparkle -->
    <path d='M82 18 L84 23 L89 25 L84 27 L82 32 L80 27 L75 25 L80 23 Z'/>
    <!-- bottom left small sparkle -->
    <path d='M12 62 L13 66 L17 67 L13 68 L12 72 L11 68 L7 67 L11 66 Z'/>
    <!-- right sparkle -->
    <path d='M88 55 L90 60 L95 62 L90 64 L88 69 L86 64 L81 62 L86 60 Z'/>
    <!-- tiny center sparkle -->
    <path d='M50 8 L51 11 L54 12 L51 13 L50 16 L49 13 L46 12 L49 11 Z'/>
    <!-- little dot sparkles -->
    <circle cx='75' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#FFF3A0'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#FFF3A0'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='75' r='2' fill='#FFF3A0'/>
    <circle cx='18' cy='80' r='2' fill='#FFF3A0'/>
  </g>
</svg>
